ROW.COLUMN: (ML/AC) Networks of Accounts, Entities, and Customers

The scenario objective is to generate an alert identifying a network of seemingly unrelated accounts, external entities, and customers. This scenario detects relationships between unrelated accounts, between internal accounts and external entities, and between customers and accounts having no known relationship. These entities can be related by transactions or through shared common attributes such as Tax ID, e-mail, Phone Number, Address, and Password.

--Bug18966229 With Prmry_Node as (select p.ntwrk_id, p.prmry_node from @MINER@.DSVIEW114699753 p ---ML_NetAcEnCu_Ntwrk_PrmryNode where p.row_num = 1),
Ntwrk_Vw AS ( SELECT nw.* FROM kdd_ntwrk nw WHERE trunc(nw.creat_ts) = (SELECT trunc(c.clndr_dt) FROM kdd_cal c WHERE c.clndr_day_age = 0 AND c.clndr_nm = 'SYSCAL' ) --Number of Nodes in the Entire Network >= Min Node Ct and Number of Nodes in the Entire Network <= Max Node Ct and nw.node_ct between @Min_Node_Ct and @Max_Node_Ct --Number of links in the Entire Network >= Min Link Ct and Number of links in the Entire Network <= Max Link Ct and nw.link_ct between @Min_Link_Ct and @Max_Link_Ct ),
Node_Vw AS ( SELECT nd.ntwrk_id FROM kdd_node nd INNER JOIN kdd_link_anlys_type_cd lt ON lt.type_id = nd.node_type_cd AND lt.type_nm = 'ACCOUNT' INNER JOIN acct a ON nd.node_bus_id = a.acct_intrl_id INNER JOIN ntwrk_vw netw ON netw.ntwrk_id = nd.ntwrk_id WHERE a.mantas_acct_holdr_type_cd = 'CR' AND a.acct_efctv_risk_nb <> - 2 GROUP BY nd.ntwrk_id HAVING --Number of households in the Entire Network >= Min Household Ct COUNT(DISTINCT coalesce(a.hh_acct_grp_id, 'NULL')) >= @Min_Household_Ct --37095735 Number of Nodes in the Entire Network <= Max Node Ct and count(node_id) <= @Max_Node_Ct ),
Link_Vw AS ( SELECT SUM(ls.tot_link_ct) trans_ct, SUM(ls.tot_link_weight) total_trans_am, ls.ntwrk_id FROM kdd_link_type_summary ls INNER JOIN kdd_link_anlys_type_cd t ON t.type_id = ls.link_type_cd INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT MAX(lk.link_ts) OVER(PARTITION BY lk.ntwrk_id) link_ts, lk.ntwrk_id FROM kdd_link lk INNER JOIN ntwrk_vw netw ON netw.ntwrk_id = lk.ntwrk_id WHERE lk.link_type_cd IN ( 116000007, 116000006 )--'JOURNALS', 'WIRES'
) l ON ls.ntwrk_id = l.ntwrk_id WHERE t.type_nm IN ( 'JOURNALS', 'WIRES' ) AND (TRUNC(l.link_ts) > (SELECT TRUNC(add_days(c.clndr_dt, - 7)) FROM kdd_cal c WHERE c.clndr_day_age = 0 AND c.clndr_nm = 'SYSCAL') OR --This parameter allows generate alert for common attributes without verification at least one transaction in the frequency period. @Common_Attr_Fl = 'Y' ) GROUP BY ls.ntwrk_id HAVING --37095735 Number of links in the Entire Network <= Max Link Ct sum(ls.tot_link_ct) <= @Max_Link_Ct
),
Trans_Node_Vw AS ( SELECT n.ntwrk_id, COUNT(1) AS trxn_node_ct FROM kdd_node n INNER JOIN ntwrk_vw nw ON nw.ntwrk_id = n.ntwrk_id WHERE n.node_total_measure IS NOT NULL GROUP BY n.ntwrk_id HAVING --37095735 Number of Nodes in the Entire Network <= Max Node Ct count(n.node_id) <= @Max_Node_Ct )
SELECT /*+ parallel(8)*/ nt.ntwrk_id , pn.prmry_node , nt.node_ct , nt.link_ct , tr.trans_ct , tr.total_trans_am , nt.avg_link_wt , nt.max_link_wt , nt.link_summary_ct , tn.trxn_node_ct FROM Ntwrk_Vw nt inner join @MANTAS@.KDD_LINK_ANLYS_NTWRK_DEFN def on def.ntwrk_defn_id = nt.ntwrk_defn_id and def.ntwrk_defn_nm='ML_NETACENCU_NTWRK' inner join Prmry_Node pn on pn.ntwrk_id = nt.ntwrk_id inner join Node_Vw hh on nt.ntwrk_id=hh.ntwrk_id inner join Link_Vw tr on tr.ntwrk_id = nt.ntwrk_id -- PR 44388 starts inner join Trans_Node_Vw tn on nt.ntwrk_id = tn.ntwrk_id -- PR 44388 ends WHERE --Number of transactions in the Entire Network >= Min Trans Ct tr.trans_ct >= @Min_Trans_Ct --Total amount of transactions in the Entire Network >= Min Trans Am and tr.total_trans_am >= @Min_Trans_Am and tn.trxn_node_ct >= @Min_Trans_Nodes -- PR 44388 -- batch name verification and ((@Include_Batch_Verification = 'Y' and nt.PRCSNG_BATCH_NM = (select prcsng_batch_nm from @MANTAS@.KDD_prcsng_batch_control)) OR (@Include_Batch_Verification = 'N') )

--Bug18966229 With Prmry_Node as (select p.ntwrk_id, p.prmry_node from @MINER@.DSVIEW114699753 p ---ML_NetAcEnCu_Ntwrk_PrmryNode where p.row_num = 1)
SELECT c.CUST_SEQ_ID , c.CUST_INTRL_ID , nw.NTWRK_ID , pn.prmry_node FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_LINK_ANLYS_TYPE_CD t inner join @MANTAS@.KDD_NODE n on t.TYPE_ID = n.NODE_TYPE_CD inner join @MANTAS@.KDD_NTWRK nw on nw.NTWRK_ID = n.NTWRK_ID inner join @MANTAS@.KDD_LINK_ANLYS_NTWRK_DEFN def on def.NTWRK_DEFN_ID = nw.NTWRK_DEFN_ID inner join Prmry_Node pn on pn.ntwrk_id = nw.ntwrk_id inner join @MINER@.CUST c on n.NODE_BUS_ID = c.CUST_INTRL_ID WHERE def.NTWRK_DEFN_NM='ML_NETACENCU_NTWRK' and nw.CREAT_TS = (select cal.clndr_dt from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and t.TYPE_NM = 'CUSTOMER' and c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- batch name verification and ((@Include_Batch_Verification = 'Y' and nw.PRCSNG_BATCH_NM = (select prcsng_batch_nm from @MANTAS@.KDD_prcsng_batch_control) and c.PRCSNG_BATCH_NM = (select prcsng_batch_nm from @MANTAS@.KDD_prcsng_batch_control) ) OR (@Include_Batch_Verification = 'N') )

-- Date: 05/04/2009 As per PR 39564 : Added filter mantas_trxn_purp_cd = 'GENERAL' for wire_trxn table --Bug18966229 With Prmry_Node as (select p.ntwrk_id, p.prmry_node from @MINER@.DSVIEW114699753 p ---ML_NetAcEnCu_Ntwrk_PrmryNode where p.row_num = 1)
SELECT w.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID , nw.NTWRK_ID , pn.prmry_node --Bug18966229 , (case when w.ORIG_NTITY_RISK_NB > 0 or w.ORIG_ACTVY_RISK_NB > 0 then w.TRXN_BASE_AM else 0 end) as Hr_Am , (case when w.PASS_THRU_FL = 'Y' then w.TRXN_BASE_AM else 0 end) as Pass_Thru_Am , (case when (w.TRXN_BASE_AM - TRUNC(w.TRXN_BASE_AM, -4)) = 0 then w.TRXN_BASE_AM when (w.RCV_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(w.RCV_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -4)) = 0 then w.TRXN_BASE_AM when (w.SEND_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(w.SEND_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -4)) = 0 then w.TRXN_BASE_AM else 0 end) as Lrf_Am
